# Wellfound

> > Wellfound is a startup-focused hiring platform connecting 10M+ candidates with 130,000+ tech jobs globally, powered by AI-driven recruitment automation.

Wellfound serves as a comprehensive job board and recruitment platform specifically designed for the startup ecosystem. The platform offers dual experiences for job seekers browsing opportunities and recruiters sourcing talent, enhanced by AI-powered tools like wellfound:ai Autopilot for automating candidate sourcing and scheduling.

## Core Platforms

- [Wellfound - Startup Job Search](https://wellfound.com): Homepage for Wellfound startup job search platform with 130,000+ roles
- [Discover Startup Jobs | Wellfound](https://wellfound.com/candidates/overview): Candidate platform to browse 100,000+ tech jobs with salary transparency
- [Hire Startup Talent | Wellfound](https://wellfound.com/recruit/overview): Recruiter platform to hire from 10M+ startup-ready candidates globally

## AI Recruitment Tools

- [wellfound:ai Autopilot: AI-Powered Candidate Sourcing and Recruitment Automation](https://wellfound.com/recruit/products/wellfound-ai-autopilot): AI-powered recruitment automation for sourcing and scheduling candidates
